units.rawText: I demand an explanation—this Balmung has nothing to do with what was agreed on regarding the game's format.

units.rawText: Are you really that desperate to win!?

units.rawText: I'm sorry, Python. The orders I received were to utterly crush the mixed human and Doll training contingent and show the world where the future of warfare truly lies.

units.rawText: You might piss me off so much I'd ensure your soldiers won't live to see tomorrow—or have you not considered that possibility?
